# LearnForge

> Open-source flashcard app with spaced repetition. It rewrites each card's question when the card is due, tracks one of six levels of understanding per card, and schedules reviews with FSRS.

LearnForge addresses the "recognition trap": after enough repetitions a learner recognises the flashcard instead of recalling the idea. When a card is due, an AI tutor (Claude) writes a new question for it. How far the question may move from the original is set per card or topic: Exact, Reworded, New context or Free. At Exact the original is asked word for word.

## Key Features
- Question variation: by default each review rewords the question and moves it to a slightly different setting
- Levels: every card has one of six Bloom's Taxonomy levels (Remember to Create); it rises with repeated good answers and steps back after misses; cards set to Exact stay on their level
- FSRS spaced repetition; harder sessions and more varied questions earn longer intervals
- With the tutor: answer by tapping (choice), typing (gaps, open answers) or dictating; open answers are graded, with follow-up questions
- Session difficulty: Commute, Desk or Deep
- Anki import: .apkg and .colpkg from current and older Anki versions, with decks and media; the schedule can be kept (image occlusion cards are imported but suspended)
- Card creation in Claude chat (MCP connector), in the web editor, or by importing a shared topic link
- Web app that can be added to a phone's home screen
- Data export as ZIP
- Open source: AGPL-3.0, self-hostable via Docker Compose

## Two ways to study
- In Claude chat: LearnForge is added as an MCP connector. No API key needed.
- In the LearnForge web app: the built-in tutor runs on the user's own Anthropic API key, billed by Anthropic. Without a key the app shows the plain cards with self-rating.

## Pricing
- 30-day free trial, no credit card required
- EUR 4.99/month, or EUR 48/year, after the trial
- AI usage is not included in the price
- Self-hosting is free (AGPL-3.0)

## Technical
- Built with: React, Fastify, PostgreSQL (pgvector), MCP protocol
- AI integration: Claude via Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the Anthropic API
- Scheduling: FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler)
- Cognitive model: Bloom's Taxonomy (6 levels)
